plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-profile-lab

> 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）用的**临时 profile 实验台**：一条命令建出隔离的 profile，装插件、跑 headless 探针会话、起驻留 web 实例验 HTTP/渲染面、读回结构化摘要、安全回收。
>
> 它存在的唯一理由：**改插件时怕把本体改暴毙**——先在隔离环境里验，确认无误再装进日常用的 profile。

- 宿主半侧插件（Cordis），注册 6 个 `tmpprofile_*` 模型工具；**没有浏览器半侧**，不声明 `dsh.client`。
- `inject` 只写 `['tools']`（**不写 `webServer`**）——所以在 headless / tui 这类没有 HTTP 服务的 profile 里不会整体 pending。
- **零第三方运行时依赖**：只用 `node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:child_process` / `node:zlib` / `node:crypto`。

---

## 它解决什么

| 老做法（每次现写脚本） | 本插件 |
|---|---|
| 想隔离测试，但官方 `--from-default-profile` 只能从 5 个内置模板初始化、**不能从现有 profile 克隆**，还要求目标目录不存在 → 手工 `New-Item` + 写 4 个文件 | `tmpprofile_create`：模板建 **或** `clone: "desktop"` 克隆（配置复制 + `node_modules` 逐项链接复用） |
| 以为 `--from-default-profile` 必然启动，没法"只建不跑" | 内部走 `--dump-config` 短路 boot（**只建、不启动**） |
| 跑探针要手拼 `DSH_HOME` + 环境变量 + `dsh --profile X "任务"`，跑完还要自己去 `sessions/` 里翻会话 | `tmpprofile_run`：一次调用完成"装配 → 跑 → 返回 sessionId 与事件摘要" |
| **验不了渲染端 / HTTP 面**（headless 根本没有 HTTP 服务），只能手搓 pwsh 起 `dsh web --port` 再 curl | `tmpprofile_web_start` / `web_probe` / `web_stop`：起**驻留 web 实例**、探任意路由、按 pid 收（跨插件重载也能收） |
| 读回验证要自己解**多帧 zstd**（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），几乎每个会话都重写一遍 Python | `tmpprofile_session`：内置逐帧解码，直接给 preset / 工具面 / 上下文 / token |
| 清理靠自觉（历史上真的漏过两次，残留至今） | `tmpprofile_clean`：清单白名单 + junction 感知删除 + 残留自检 |
| junction 直接 `Remove-Item -Recurse` 有删进源仓库的风险 | 先 `lstat` 判链接、解链接，再递归删目录；**绝不跟随链接** |

---

## 安装

```powershell
# 从本地目录装（开发态）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:/repository/dsh-profile-lab

# 或从 GitHub 装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:<你的账号>/dsh-profile-lab
```

装完**重启 DSH**（插件在启动时装配）。桌面版的 profile 由 Electron 独占管理，命令行直连会被拒——用桌面版插件页装，或走应用内通道。

---

## 十个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 | 关键参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `tmpprofile_create` | 建隔离 profile（模板 / 克隆）＋可选装包 | `name`、`template`（默认 `headless`）、`clone`、`packages`、`purpose`、`overwrite` |
| `tmpprofile_install` | 往已登记的临时 profile 追加安装 / 移除 | `name`、`packages`、`remove` |
| `tmpprofile_run` | 跑一次 headless 探针会话（同步、带超时） | `name`、`task`、`sessionId`、`env`、`timeoutMs`、`json` |
| `tmpprofile_web_start` | 起**驻留 web 实例**（真实 HTTP 服务，验 host 路由/渲染面） | `name`、`port`、`probePath`、`waitMs`、`cwd`、`env` |
| `tmpprofile_web_probe` | 对驻留实例发一次 HTTP 探针 | `name`、`path`、`method`、`timeoutMs` |
| `tmpprofile_web_stop` | 停掉驻留实例（`taskkill /T /F` + 确认端口释放） | `name`、`waitMs` |
| `tmpprofile_session` | 读会话日志给结构化摘要 | `sessionId` 或 `name`、`sections`、`limit` |
| `tmpprofile_list` | 列出「本插件管的」与「未登记的」profile | — |
| `tmpprofile_clean` | 清理（默认 dry-run，需 `confirm: true`；会先停实例） | `names`、`confirm`、`sessions`、`archiveTo` |
| `tmpprofile_fingerprint` | 采集 `profiles/` 指纹，自查有没有碰到别的 profile | `exclude` |

> 工具名以 `tmpprofile_` 开头，便于在 `dsh-tool-manager` 里整组启用/禁用。

**典型闭环（模型视角）**：

```
# A. host 面：装配 + 工具面 + 会话行为
tmpprofile_create  { name: "probeA", template: "headless", purpose: "验证 dsh-xxx 的工具面", packages: ["link:C:/plugins/dsh-xxx"] }
tmpprofile_run     { name: "probeA", task: "只回复两个字：OK" }
tmpprofile_session { name: "probeA", sections: ["preset","tools","contexts"] }

# B. 渲染 / HTTP 面：起真实例，探插件的 host 路由
tmpprofile_create    { name: "webA", template: "web", packages: ["link:C:/plugins/dsh-xxx"] }
tmpprofile_web_start { name: "webA", probePath: "/api/dsh-xxx/status" }
tmpprofile_web_stop  { name: "webA" }

tmpprofile_clean   { names: ["probeA", "webA"], confirm: true }
```

> **web 实例与 headless 探针验的不是同一件事**：headless 给 **host 侧装配事实**
> （哪个 entry 没激活、卡在等哪个服务），web 实例给 **HTTP/渲染面事实**
> （端口真的在听、插件的 host 路由真的注册了、页面能加载）。两者都要，才有完整画像。
> 注意 `web_start` 要求 profile 的 bundles 里有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`——
> 用 `template: "web"` 建，或从带 web-app 的 profile 克隆。

更多配方见 [docs/RECIPES.md](docs/RECIPES.md)。

---

## 安全护栏（都是刻意的）

1. **只动自己建的**：只有登记在 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.json` 里的临时 profile 才可被写/删；`desktop` / `backup` / `web` / `headless` / `dsh-tui` / `rescue` / `reserve` / `acp` / `sdk` / `sdk-minimal` 一律硬拒。
2. **删链接不删目标**：`node_modules` 里的 junction/symlink 先 `lstat` 判定再解链接，然后才递归删目录。
3. **克隆不共享写面**：克隆时 `node_modules` 里的每一项单独链接（不是整目录一个链接），所以随后 `pnpm add` 只改写新 profile，源 profile 一个字节都不动。
4. **clean 默认演练**：不传 `confirm: true` 只返回"将要删除什么"。
5. **覆盖要显式**：`overwrite: true` 只允许覆盖已登记的同名 profile，旧的挪到 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-trash/`，不直接删。
6. **失败留痕**：profile 先登记再装包，装包失败也留在清单里，能被 `tmpprofile_clean` 回收。
7. **进程内 + 跨进程锁**：同一 profile 不允许并发运行；跨进程写操作走 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.lock`（陈旧锁 120s 自动抢占）。
8. **审计日志**：每次 create / install / run / clean 追加一行到 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-log.jsonl`。
9. **驻留实例是刻意的例外，且加倍设防**：`tmpprofile_web_start` 起的 web 实例会**驻留**（这是它存在的意义），所以：同一 profile 只允许一个实例；端口从 19399 起自动挑空闲的；stdout/stderr 只留尾部环形缓冲；进程**不 detach**（留在宿主 Job Object 内，宿主退出连带杀掉）；插件卸载时 `killAllWebInstances()` 再扫一遍；`tmpprofile_clean` 删目录前先按清单 pid 停实例。
10. **不做后台任务**：DSH 的子进程在宿主的 Job Object 里（宿主退出会连带杀死），所以 `tmpprofile_run` 一律**同步 + 超时**（默认 300s，上限 900s，超时 `taskkill /T /F` 杀整棵进程树）；唯一的常驻形态就是上面那三条 `web_*` 工具，并且必须由调用方显式停止（或用 `clean` 兜底）。

---

## 配置（cordis 行 config，全部可选）

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-profile-lab
      name: 'dsh-profile-lab'
      config:
        home: 'C:/Users/you/.dsh'      # 缺省 $DSH_HOME 或 ~/.dsh
        dshBin: ''                      # 显式指定 dsh 的 lib/bin.js（缺省自动探测）
        nodePath: ''                    # 显式指定跑子进程的 node（缺省 process.execPath）
        tools:
          disabled: ['tmpprofile_fingerprint']   # 按名字关掉工具
```

### dsh 可执行文件是怎么找的

按优先级探测，每条都用 `-V` **实测**（`app.asar` 是文件，`existsSync` 看不到内部路径，只能试跑）：

1. `config.dshBin` / 环境变量 `DSH_LAB_DSH_BIN`
2. **宿主安装锚点**：宿主进程的 `profileContext.installAnchor` → `<安装>/…/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js`，用 `process.execPath` + `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`（版本与宿主一致，兼容性最好）
3. npm 全局安装：`%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js`
4. `C:\dsh-runtime\<版本>\...`

实测样例（Windows + 桌面版宿主）：宿主锚点 → `0.2.0-rc.2`（host 同版本）；兜底 npm 全局 → `0.2.1-alpha.1`。

---

## 会话日志是怎么读的

`session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 是**多帧** zstd（DSH 每追加一批事件压一帧）。Node 的 `zstdDecompressSync` 对多帧输入**只解第一帧且不报错**，也不暴露"剩余未消费字节"——整段丢进去只拿到 254 字节的 header。

官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 的做法是：按 zstd 魔数（`0xFD2FB528`，小端 `28 B5 2F FD`）扫描帧起点，再逐帧解压。本插件用同一思路并利用"one-shot 只解第一帧"的特性把实现压到最短：对每个魔数偏移试解一次，成功即得该帧，伪魔数（解出来不是 `{` 开头）直接跳过。

实测：6.51 MiB 压缩 → **4322 帧** → 20 MiB 文本 → 6901 事件，摘要正确。

---

## 两个 DSH 侧的坑（本插件都已堵掉）

1. **工具返回值必须是 lossless JSON**。只要返回值里出现 `undefined`（哪怕只是某个可选字段），DSH 会把整条结果拒收，模型看到的是
   `tool "x" returned invalid output: value is not lossless JSON` 而不是数据。本插件在所有工具出口统一做了一次净化（丢 `undefined`、非有限数转 `null`）。
2. **headless 的 `--json` 是投影，不是日志**。它用自己的一套事件名（`tool_call`、`tool_result`、`status`、`thinking`…），**不含**日志里的 `tool/call`；
   官方文档也明说它"caps every string except the terminal `final` at 8 KiB and omits events the projection does not model"。
   所以「到底调了哪些工具」必须以磁盘上的完整会话日志为准——`tmpprofile_run` 已经替你把这一步做了：返回值里的 `session.tools` 就是完整日志的工具面。

---

## 自检

装好之后（或改动代码之后）可以直接跑内置自检——它会真建一个临时 profile、装本插件、跑一次 headless 让模型调用 `tmpprofile_list`、再清理：

```powershell
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs
```

退出码 0 表示插件在真实 DSH 里能加载、工具可被调用、清理无残留。

---

## 测试

```powershell
# 单元测试（全部在临时 DSH_HOME 里跑，不碰真实环境）
npm test

# 真实闭环（会真建 profile、真跑一次 headless、真清理；消耗极少量 token）
$env:DSH_LAB_LIVE='1'; node --test tests/live.test.js
```

live 测试的硬断言：**除本次建的临时 profile 外，`profiles/` 里其他 profile 的指纹（hash + mtime）必须一个字节不变**。

---

## 限制（明确不做）

- **不是危机救援工具**：主力 profile 起不来时，本插件也起不来。要救援请用 `rescue` / `reserve` 实例。
- **web 实例只验到"服务端+静态资源"这一层**：端口在听、路由在答、页面 HTML 能取到；页面里 JS 真的执行、UI 真的渲染出来，只有真浏览器加载才会发生（需要的话自己打开 `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` 看）。
- **不做脱离宿主的任务**：见上文 Job Object。
- **不自动纳管已有的临时 profile**：`profiles/` 里历史残留（例如早年手工建的目录）会出现在 `unmanaged` 列表里，需要你确认后用 `adoptProfile` 显式纳管，本插件不会自动动它们。
- **共享 `DSH_HOME`**：探针会话仍写在主力的 `sessions/` / `storages/` 下（同一 home 无跨进程锁）。要彻底隔离得用独立 `DSH_HOME`，尚未实现。

---

## 文件位置

| 内容 | 路径 |
|---|---|
| 清单 | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.json` |
| 审计日志 | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-log.jsonl` |
| 跨进程锁 | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.lock` |
| 覆盖时丢弃的旧 profile | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-trash/` |
| 临时 profile | `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/` |

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic write gate for DeepSeek Harness — scope policy + residue scan at the moment of the write; the CI gate moved into the session
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pr-gate

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

Deterministic write gate for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) —
**the CI gate moved to the moment of the write.**

Every file the agent writes (`write` / `edit` / `str_replace_editor`) passes
the same scope policy and residue rules that
[agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate) applies to PRs
in CI — deny-before-write in `tools/pre-execute`, residue scan of the written
text in `tools/post-execute`, and a durable content-hashed JSONL ledger of
every decision. Zero LLM calls in the trust path: the parts of the gate that
must NOT be an LLM live here.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

The review/guard lane in the dsh ecosystem is entirely LLM-shaped:
answer-reviewer plugins re-read turns with a second model, `dsh-gungnir`
verifies goal completion from exit codes, and the closest action-guard
(`cc-safety-net`, 1.6k★ in the Claude ecosystem) blocks destructive commands.
**Nobody gates what the agent writes deterministically** — scope policy,
residue markers, or a durable record the CI can consume. That slot is empty,
and this plugin is the [agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate)
engine living inside the runtime instead of waiting for the PR.

## What it does

| Stage | Hook | Deterministic action |
|---|---|---|
| Before the write | `tools/pre-execute` | Scope policy: deny globs always win; a non-empty allow list means "only these". Denied writes never touch the disk |
| After the write | `tools/post-execute` | Residue scan of the written text: injection text aimed at reviewers, skipped tests, debug markers. `warn` (default) logs + ledgers; `block` also fails the write with corrective feedback |
| Always | JSONL ledger | One line per decision — tool, path, action, `sha256` of content, matched pattern, residue kinds. `agent-pr-gate` CI can consume it as the session-side record |

## One policy, two enforcement points

Point `policyFile` at your repo's `agent-pr-gate.yaml` and the live session
enforces the same allow/deny the CI gate enforces on PRs — all policy entries
are unioned. Inline `allow`/`deny` config works without a file.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-pr-gate
```

From npm — no build step, no `allowBuilds` authorization; git installs are equally prebuilt (`lib/` ships in the repo).



## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-pr-gate
  name: dsh-pr-gate
  config:
    tools: [write, edit, str_replace_editor]
    allow: [src/**, docs/**]     # non-empty = only these
    deny: ["**/*.pem", .github/workflows/**]
    policyFile: ""               # or e.g. agent-pr-gate.yaml
    residueMode: warn            # warn | block
    ledgerPath: .dsh-pr-gate/session.jsonl
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-pr-gate] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-pr-gate` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test   # syncs the vendored agent-pr-gate core, builds, runs unit tests
```

The scope glob semantics and residue rules are vendored from the sibling
`agent-pr-gate` checkout (`npm run sync`; CI runs `sync --check`).

## Roadmap

- `bash` command write-heuristics (redirect/shell-write detection, warn-only)
- Ledger → GitHub check-run bridge (session attestations surfaced in CI)
- Per-policy selection by agent preset, matching the CI gate's policy classes
- Claims-vs-diff at turn end (the agent's final summary vs. the session ledger)

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party deterministic write gating, or reviewer plugins
converge on deterministic enforcement (they are all LLM-based today), this
freezes at its last working version with a postmortem here. The engine stays
owned by agent-pr-gate either way.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compact

**English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Local reverse proxy between [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (or any OpenAI-compatible client) and your LLM gateway. It **keeps recent turns verbatim** and **summarizes older context**, so the same chat can continue without `ContextWindowExceededError`.

```text
Client  →  http://127.0.0.1:4001/v1  →  dsh-compact  →  your OpenAI-compatible upstream
```

> **Daily start:** [Mac](HOW_TO_START_MAC.md) · [Windows](HOW_TO_START_WINDOWS.md)

---

## Set up with a coding agent

Copy this into your coding agent:

```text
Install and configure dsh-compact for local use on this machine.

1. Detect OS (macOS / Windows) and show a short setup plan; wait for my approval before changing anything.
2. Create ~/.dsh-compact/venv (or Windows equivalent), pip install -r requirements.txt.
3. Ask me for COMPANY_LLM_BASE, COMPANY_LLM_MODEL, and COMPANY_LLM_KEY (optional: DASH_COMPACT_SUMMARIZE_*).
   Write them to ~/.dsh-compact/env.sh on macOS (chmod 600) or User-level environment variables on Windows.
   Never commit secrets to git.
4. Follow HOW_TO_START_MAC.md or HOW_TO_START_WINDOWS.md; start `python proxy.py` (background OK).
5. Verify with: curl http://127.0.0.1:4001/health  — expect enabled=true and the configured upstream.
6. Tell me to set the client (DeepSeek Harness / DSH) Base URL to http://127.0.0.1:4001/v1,
   API protocol = OpenAI Chat Completions, then Apply and restart the session.
```

You still provide API keys and click Apply in the client UI; the agent installs the local proxy and verifies `/health`.

---

## Features

- **Invisible compaction**: past the threshold, older messages are summarized in the background; recent turns stay verbatim and are injected on the next request
- **Transparent proxy**: rewrites outbound request bodies only; never mutates local transcripts; binds to `127.0.0.1` only
- **Free first pass**: strip base64 images / huge dumps; shrink old tool results (micro-compact)
- **Resilient**: chunked summarization, 429 retries, cooldown and circuit breaker
- **Emergency CLI**: if a session cannot open, `compact.py` produces a pasteable `brief.md`

---

## Architecture

No fork, no npm, no TLS termination. A plain HTTP reverse proxy on `127.0.0.1` runs **keep-recent / summarize-old + rolling merge** on OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions`. Offline CLI is emergency-only.

```text
                 ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
Client           │  dsh-compact local proxy  127.0.0.1:4001                  │
  │              │                                                          │
  │ POST /v1/chat/completions                                               │
  │ (Base URL    │  1. Read messages + estimate tokens (prefer real usage)  │
  │  → :4001)    │  2. strip: base64 images → placeholders (strip_heavy)    │
  ▼              │  3. micro: old tool results → placeholders (free)        │
                 │  4. Over threshold? Summarize old msgs → rolling merge   │
                 │     Keep recent turns verbatim                           │
Upstream LLM     │  5. Send [rolling summary] + [recent] upstream           │
 OpenAI-compat   │  6. Stream response back to client (no full buffer)      │
                 │                                                          │
                 │  · In-memory state; match cache by content hash          │
                 │  · Prefer async compress: allow this turn, inject next   │
                 └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| Mode | Artifact | Trigger | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primary: local proxy | `proxy.py` | Auto when tokens exceed threshold | Continue same session |
| Emergency: offline CLI | `compact.py` | Manual | Produce `brief.md` handoff |

**Invariants:**

- Only rewrites the body sent upstream; local transcript is **never** modified
- Loopback only; no TLS MITM
- Special-cases `/v1/chat/completions`; other paths pass through; unknown fields preserved
- Protocol is **OpenAI Chat Completions** (`tool_calls` + `role:"tool"`)

**Defaults (tune to your window):** `TRIGGER=180000`, `TARGET=80000`, `HARD_LIMIT=240000`; session identity via messages content-hash. Token estimates count CJK, `reasoning_content`, and `tools` schemas; a large request body can also force compaction (`DASH_COMPACT_BODY_TRIGGER_BYTES`).

### Request pipeline

```text
Estimate tokens each request (messages + tools; CJK / reasoning aware)
  → under TRIGGER and body under BODY_TRIGGER: forward as-is
  → over threshold (or large body):
       1) micro: old tool_result → placeholder (no LLM)
       2) summarize old messages only → merge into rolling summary
       3) keep recent messages verbatim
       4) upstream payload = [rolling summary] + [recent]
  → prefer async: allow current turn, inject on the next
  → at HARD_LIMIT (or large body past TRIGGER): sync-compress before forward
```

Logs with `Compression #N`, `injected=True`, and `tokens≈large->small` mean compaction worked.

### Bench snapshot

Synthetic fixtures and a local token estimate (`python -m bench.free_layer`). `free` is the share left after strip + micro. `post` is the size after a summary cut; `end` is `post / raw`. A dash means that cell was not run. Image rows are mostly base64 padding, so their drop is larger than a real screenshot session.

| Sample | raw | strip | micro | free | post | end | recall | headings |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| chat_short | 10500 | 10500 | 10500 | 1.000 | — | — | — | — |
| chat_over_trigger | 195000 | 195000 | 195000 | 1.000 | 97965 | 0.503 | 5/5 | 7/7 |
| chat_near_hard_limit | 233999 | 233999 | 233999 | 1.000 | 87858 | 0.375 | — | — |
| tools_short | 6170 | 6170 | 4094 | 0.664 | — | — | — | — |
| tools_over_trigger | 195000 | 21770 | 13844 | 0.071 | 10978 | 0.056 | — | — |
| tools_near_hard_limit | 233999 | 21770 | 13844 | 0.059 | 10978 | 0.047 | — | — |
| images_short | 10500 | 378 | 378 | 0.036 | — | — | — | — |
| images_over_trigger | 195000 | 378 | 378 | 0.002 | 162 | 0.001 | — | — |
| images_near_hard_limit | 233999 | 378 | 378 | 0.002 | 162 | 0.001 | — | — |

`recall` and `headings` are from a real summarizer (`python -m bench.quality`). Only `chat_over_trigger` has been scored: 195000 → 97965 in 5.88s, all 5 gold facts kept, all 7 `prompt.txt` headings present, `RECENT_ANCHOR` still verbatim, summary 1317 characters. Other `post` / `end` cells are the fake-summarizer size bench.

Plain chat has nothing for the free pass to remove; the summary brings ~190k–234k down to ~88k–98k (`TARGET=80000`). Tool dumps and base64 images shrink in the free pass, before the summary cut.

---

## Requirements

- Python 3.10+
- Any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` upstream
- Client can point Base URL at localhost (**OpenAI Chat Completions** protocol)

---

## Quick Start

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

export COMPANY_LLM_BASE="https://api.example.com/v1"   # your upstream
export COMPANY_LLM_MODEL="your-model"
export COMPANY_LLM_KEY="sk-..."                        # summarizer fallback; chat key may live only in the client
# Recommended: separate summarizer credentials
# export DASH_COMPACT_SUMMARIZE_BASE=... MODEL=... KEY=...

python proxy.py
# curl http://127.0.0.1:4001/health
```

In the client:

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base URL | `http://127.0.0.1:4001/v1` |
| API protocol | OpenAI Chat Completions |
| API Key | Real upstream key |
| Model | Same as upstream |

Apply, then restart the session. Full steps: [HOW_TO_START_MAC.md](HOW_TO_START_MAC.md) / [HOW_TO_START_WINDOWS.md](HOW_TO_START_WINDOWS.md).

---

## Configuration

Read secrets from environment variables only; never commit them.

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `COMPANY_LLM_BASE` | Chat upstream Base URL (required) |
| `COMPANY_LLM_MODEL` | Upstream model name |
| `COMPANY_LLM_KEY` | Fallback key when summarizer vars unset |
| `DASH_COMPACT_SUMMARIZE_*` | Optional summarizer BASE / MODEL / KEY |
| `DASH_COMPACT_TRIGGER` | Trigger line, default `180000` |
| `DASH_COMPACT_TARGET` | Post-compact recent-context budget, defa

plugins.description: Automatic guitar-tab transcriber & synced player generator as an Agent Skill — works with DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude Code and compatible harnesses
plugins.readme_text:
# Guitar Tab Maker · 吉他谱工坊

自动扒歌 + 生成「边播放边跳和弦」的吉他跟练播放器。技能目录形式，遵循 [Agent Skills](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/agent-skills) 规范（`SKILL.md` + `scripts/`），**可直接被 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）、Claude Code 等兼容 harness 加载**。

## 它做什么

输入一首歌的音频（mp3/wav/m4a/flac），输出单文件 HTML 播放器：

- 原曲音频内嵌（**不转调、不损伤音质**）
- 和弦随播放进度跳动高亮，附下一个和弦预告
- 每个和弦带指法图（开放和弦 + 大横按）
- 每小节标注扫弦箭头（8 个八分音符格）
- 歌词逐行同步、段落快捷跳转、播放变速跟练

## 工作管线

| 脚本 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `scripts/fetch_lrc.py` | 双通道抓带时间轴歌词（酷我 musicId 优先，网易云兜底） |
| `scripts/analyze_song.py` | librosa 扒谱：beat 追踪 + 调内白名单 HMM/Viterbi + 小节制合并 |
| `scripts/verify_song.py` | 音频-谱面一致性校验（低频频谱根音比对），防原调标错/文件错配 |
| `scripts/build_songs.py` | 按配置重建曲库；指法和弦按 `(原调根音 − capo) mod 12` 自动换算 |
| `scripts/build_player.py` | 音频 base64 注入模板，生成单文件 HTML |
| `scripts/validate_player.py` | 成品综合校验（占位符/字段/段落索引/图库覆盖） |

## 快速开始

依赖：Python 3.10+、[ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)、Node.js（仅 harness 加载需要）。

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1) 歌词
python scripts/fetch_lrc.py --title 歌名 --artist 歌手 --kuwo-id 358603096 --out lrc.json
# 2) 扒谱（原调根音与 BPM 为粗略先验，可用网络资料）
python scripts/analyze_song.py --audio song.mp3 --key-root Bb --key-mode minor --bpm 89 --lrc lrc.json --out analysis.json
# 3) 一致性校验（必跑）
python scripts/verify_song.py --audio song.mp3 --analysis analysis.json
# 4) 写配置（参考 examples/songs.example.json）后构建
python scripts/build_songs.py --config songs.json --template assets/player_template.html --out built.html
python scripts/build_player.py --template built.html --out player.html --audio 1=song.mp3
# 5) 终验
python scripts/validate_player.py player.html
```

完整 SOP、变调夹选法与踩坑检查点见 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)。

## 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用

把整个目录放到 dsh 的技能发现路径即可，无需转换：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`（或 `~/.agents/skills/`，Claude Code 同根）
- 项目级：`<repo>/.agents/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`

dsh 只发现发现根下的**直接**子目录（不递归），不要嵌套两层。frontmatter 支持 `disable-model-invocation`、`user-invocable` 两个 dsh 专属开关。

## 免责声明

- 输出为**参考级谱面**：AI 听辨的切换点可能有小偏差，可在 `SONGS` 数据中改 `t` 值自行校准。
- 本仓库**不含任何歌曲音频或歌词**；请仅对自己有权使用的内容扒谱，并自行处理版权。
- MIT License。

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Chess Game

国际象棋 × 两种形态：**单文件网页版**（双人同屏）+ **DeepSeek Harness Web 插件**（悬浮窗，双人/人机对战，PGN 导出）。零依赖、完全离线。

## 网页版（index.html）

两个人在同一台电脑上用鼠标轮流对战，浏览器打开 `index.html` 即玩。

- 白方先行，点一下自己的棋子（显示可走格圆点），再点一下目标格落子
- 红圈表示可吃子；被将军的王红圈高亮提示

## DSH 插件 dsh-chess-float（packages/chess-float/）

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里下棋：输入框工具栏 **♟ 按钮** → 弹出**可拖动悬浮窗**。

**功能**：

- 双人对战 / 人机对战（可选执白或执黑）
- 人机 AI：本地 negamax + αβ 剪枝引擎，5 级难度（入门→大师，难度=搜索深度，低难度带随机失误），毫秒级响应、零模型调用、完全离线
- 完整规则：王车易位、吃过路兵、兵升变、将杀、逼和、50 回合规则、子力不足和棋
- 悔棋（人机模式自动回退双方各一步）、SAN 标准记谱、**PGN 棋谱导出**（可导入 Lichess / chess.com 复盘）
- 主题 token 适配明暗主题

**安装**：

```bash
# 从源码（本仓库）
dsh plugin add packages/chess-float

# 离线安装（其他机器）
mkdir -p ~/plugins/chess-float
tar -xzf dsh-chess-float-1.2.0.tgz -C ~/plugins/chess-float --strip-components=1
dsh plugin add ~/plugins/chess-float
```

预构建 tarball 见 [Releases](https://github.com/x-cores/dsh-chess-game/releases)。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可看到 ♟ 按钮。

## 正确性验证

走法引擎通过标准 perft 校验（走法枚举数与国际象棋公认参考值完全一致）：

| 测试局面 | 深度 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 初始局面 | 1–4 层 | 20 / 400 / 8,902 / 197,281 ✓ |
| CPW #3（吃过路兵密集） | 1–5 层 | 14 / 191 / 2,812 / 43,238 / 674,624 ✓ |
| CPW #4（易位/升变密集） | 1–4 层 | 6 / 264 / 9,467 / 422,333 ✓ |

AI 引擎验证：深度 3 对随机对手 71 步将杀（约 44ms/步）；大师(5) 单步约 1.2s。

## 运行测试

```bash
node test-perft.js      # perft 规则校验
node test-gameplay.js   # 完整对局路径模拟（易位/过路兵/升变/SAN）
```

plugins.description: Deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - monotonic guard seam, operator-declared policy, decision ledger. Gate: 12/12 green, 2000 benign FP=0, injected 7/7 caught.
plugins.readme_text:
# @phm-audit/dsh-action-guard

A deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), registered through the official **monotonic guard seam** (`ctx.tools.guard`).

> DeepSeek Harness follows an "everything is a plugin" architecture. This plugin fills one concrete slot: a rules-based, operator-declared guard whose verdicts are reproducible and whose decisions are recorded.

Gate test artifact: 2009-frame deterministic command stream (2000 benign + 7 injected violations + determinism/ledger/pathological-input checks, no RNG, no network) — **0 false positives on benign, all injected violations caught by the intended rule**, 12/12 vitest cases green (2026-10-13). Run: `bash run_demo.sh`.

End-to-end smoke: the Cordis wrapper is additionally verified against the **published npm packages** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-10-13) — loaded the cordis way (`ctx.plugin`, `static inject` resolved), a real tool registered, and a real `execute()` call to a non-allowlisted tool **denied with the expected R-unknown reason through the actual pipeline** (3/3 smoke cases). Version-pinned smoke: the harness is under active development; re-run `npx vitest run tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against your deployed version.

## What it checks (all operator-declared, all deterministic)

- **R-unknown** — tool must be in the declared allowlist
- **R-keys** — forbidden parameter keys per tool
- **R-equals** — denied parameter values per tool
- **R-bounds** — numeric parameter bounds per tool (inclusive)
- **Fail-closed** — an internal evaluation error denies with a distinctive reason (a broken guard can never silently become a hole)
- **Decision ledger** — every verdict appended to a local JSONL ledger with a chain id (correlation artifact for incident forensics; FNV-based chain id, not a tamper-proofing guarantee)

## Method lineage — PHM

This plugin is the harness-native expression of the **PHM deterministic-verification methodology** (gate-first, evidence-first), whose parent project [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) is validated on the **AgentDojo official benchmark with a real LLM in the loop** (no ASR/FP events in the v2.2 re-run, FP fix-cycle 16 → 1 → 0 published, all artifacts open with SHA-256 chains, third-party thread engagement on record).

What that lineage means concretely, versus the (crowded, 155-plugin) Security & Permissions category:

1. **Official third-party benchmark lineage** — the parent method is measured on AgentDojo, not only on self-built samples (verified 2026-10-13 across a 10-repo sample of direct competitors: none cites an industry-standard benchmark; the closest, dsh-defend, uses a self-built 105-sample red-team set).
2. **Cross-domain deployment record** — the same gate criteria (benign FP=0 / injected FN=0 / deterministic repeats / fail-closed / audit ledger) run in robot (Unitree official-URDF gate), traffic-flow (845k-frame NGSIM), and SDK-contract lines — a method with a track record, not a one-off plugin.
3. **Open, recomputable evidence** — every claim in this README has an on-disk artifact: gate counts in `tests/`, smoke in `tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against published npm versions, SHA-256SUMS manifest.

The category being crowded is stated on purpose: this plugin's value is the evidence chain and the standard-interface demonstration, not feature uniqueness.

## Channel facts (from the #9614 review — thanks @argszero)

Four properties of the guard seam that scope what this plugin's ledger and rules can claim, verified against `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` at master (`d743267388`):

1. **The ledger is a guard-layer record, not a complete decision record.** The guard runs only when the pre-execute waterfall returned `allow` (and the user did not refuse an ask, and the call was not cancelled upstream). Denials owned by other layers never enter the guard — a complete audit record needs `tools/pre-execute` + `tools/post-execute` as writers. Our JSONL ledger describes exactly this layer and nothing more.
2. **`R-unknown` is a *name* allowlist, not a *tool* allowlist.** `execution.name` can resolve to different registered definitions across scopes (scope registrations shadow inherited entries). A same-named shadow preset is indistinguishable to the guard.
3. **PTC mode changes the traffic shape.** Model-direct calls of native tool names are denied upstream (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) before the policy pipeline; nested sub-dispatches *do* reach the guard (inheriting `rootCallId`). Policies must therefore cover sub-dispatch argument shapes too, and the allowlist only sees what actually arrives.
4. **Structured denial metadata is channel-forced external.** A guard can only return a string; `denialInfo` in the pipeline comes from the waterfall's decision. The separate JSONL ledger is the channel's requirement, not a stylistic choice — and the refusal reason is model-facing (`Error: <reason>` is the tool result), so keep reasons short and carry the rule id (`action-guard: … (R-bounds)`) to correlate with the ledger.

**Why the guard seam (and not a `tools/pre-execute` listener):** a guard is monotonic — no other layer can force-allow what it denied — while a pre-execute listener sits in a waterfall it does not own, and one early `allow` ends the chain for everyone after it. Deterministic, synchronous, name+arguments policy belongs here; operator-visible asks belong to the waterfall.

**Mount-point note:** all guards are monotonic-deny, so the outcome is order-independent — but the *reported reason* is the first one found (global first, then scope chain farthest-first). If your policy can deny the same call from two layers, pin a single mount point to keep reported rule ids unambiguous.

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

- The policy is **operator-declared** — this is not a general safety oracle, and it does not replace the harness's own permission/sandbox/approval layers; it composes with them at the guard seam.
- Same-source fix cycles are not independent stability trials. The 2009-frame gate is a mechanism demonstration, not a statistical claim.
- The guard core is a pure function (`src/guard-core.ts`, zero dependencies); the Cordis wrapper (`src/index.ts`) imports `ToolGuard` from the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package and is smoke-tested as described above. One earlier revision imported a wrong internal-only package name; the smoke test against npm packages is the guard against that class of error.
- Ledger writes are best-effort and contained; they cannot affect the verdict path.

## Plugin shape (matches harness plugin conventions)

```ts
export const name = 'action-guard'
export const inject = ['tools']
export interface Config { policy: GuardPolicy; ledger?: { path: string } }
export default apply   // registers one ToolGuard via ctx.tools.guard()
```

## License

MIT.

---

**PHM evidence chain** — aggregate ledger: [phm-evidence-ledger](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/phm-evidence-ledger) (5,000,086,001 units, four layers, open metrics + SHA-256 manifest) · method parent: [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) (AgentDojo-validated) · [PHM-Audit profile](https://github.com/PHM-Audit)

plugins.description: Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images through any OpenAI-compatible image backend
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-imagegen

Image-generation plugin for dsh: one `imagegen` tool that renders images
through any OpenAI-compatible image backend, so agents can generate images
without per-backend glue. The same tool lists the configured routes, echoes
the declared model lists, and live-probes the backends.

## Tool verbs

| verb        | network | what it does |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `generate`  | yes     | Generates the requested images. The tool writes the image files to disk and runs magic-byte checks on them. |
| `providers` | no      | Lists the configured routes with their fields, the originating layer of each field, and the credential state. The verb reads the local configuration and makes no network request. |
| `models`    | no      | Echoes the declared model list of each route from the config layer. The verb makes no network request; the live model listing is the `status` verb. |
| `status`    | yes     | Probes each route's `GET {baseURL}/models` endpoint and reports reachability plus the live model list. |

Key `generate` behaviors:

- The `prompt` argument is required, and it is the only required argument.
- When the call omits `model`, the tool uses the route's single declared
  model. When a route declares no models, the tool resolves the model by a
  live `/models` probe. When the declared or probed model list contains
  several models, the call fails and lists the candidates.
- The tool sends `size` and `negativePrompt` verbatim, and only when the call
  sets them. The `seed` argument must be an integer, and the tool sends it
  only when the call sets it. The `n` argument is an integer >= 1 with a
  default of 1, and a value greater than 1 requests a batch.
- When the call sets `out`, the output path is that argument (a file path for
  `n = 1`, or a directory marked by a trailing separator or by existing on
  disk). When the call omits `out`, the tool writes the files to
  `<process.cwd()>/images/<unixts>_<i>.<ext>`. The file extension comes from
  the image magic bytes (`png` / `jpg` / `webp`).
- The tool checks the written bytes for PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. When the
  payload is not a recognized image, the call fails with `code: output`, and
  the tool keeps the file on disk. When the path cannot be written, the call
  fails the same way.
- The generate timeout is 180 s by default, and a `timeout` argument of
  1-3600 s overrides it per call. The probe timeout is 10 s.

The plugin ships a `dsh-imagegen` skill. The skill is the full tool reference
for agent contexts: it carries the parameter table, the env contract, and the
error codes.

## Installation

dsh-imagegen is an out-of-tree plugin for a dsh profile. Install it with the
dsh plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-imagegen
```

Configuration is layered: built-in defaults, the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract, a
cordis patch file, a `dsh-imagegen` settings section (see below); the plugin
creates no config or state files.

## Configuration

Providers are configured in any of four layers, lowest to highest priority;
the `providers` verb reports the originating layer of every field, so a
shadowed value is never silent:

1. the built-in default (`api: openai-compatible`),
2. the `IMAGEGEN_*` env contract (static per process boot),
3. the cordis config layer (a patch entry with id `dsh-imagegen` and a
   `config` object, or profile-level patches),
4. the `dsh-imagegen:` section in the user settings document
   (`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`), which the plugin re-reads on every call, so
   settings edits apply without a restart.

```yaml
dsh-imagegen:
  defaultProvider: local
  providers:
    local:
      baseURL: http://<host>:<port>/v1
    hosted:
      baseURL: https://api.example.com/v1
      apiKeyEnv: IMAGEGEN_HOSTED_KEY
      models: [flux-1]
      displayName: Hosted Images
```

The env contract mirrors the config fields 1:1: `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`,
and per route `<NAME>` the variables `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_BASEURL`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_API`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_APIKEYENV`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_HEADERS`, `IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_MODELS`,
`IMAGEGEN_PROVIDER_<NAME>_DISPLAYNAME`. The `<NAME>` segment is the route name
uppercased with `-` written as `_`. The `headers` value is a JSON object
string, and the `models` value is a comma-separated list of model ids. The
`baseURL` value is the OpenAI-compatible base URL including the `/v1` prefix
(the same shape as an LLM provider base URL); the plugin appends
`/images/generations` and `/models` to it verbatim, and the image contract has
no server-root endpoints. The `apiKeyEnv` value is a reference to an
environment variable name, never a secret in config; per request the value
resolves from the process environment, then from
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.

## Examples

```jsonc
// Generate with the default route and its single declared model.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "a lighthouse in fog", "size": "1024x1024" }
// Pick a route and model explicitly, and keep the output name deterministic.
{ "verb": "generate", "provider": "hosted", "model": "flux-1",
  "prompt": "an isometric pixel-art garden", "seed": 42, "out": "/tmp/garden.png" }
// Generate a batch into an existing directory.
{ "verb": "generate", "prompt": "three weather variations", "n": 3, "out": "renders/" }
// List what is configured, and where each field comes from.
{ "verb": "providers" }
// List the declared model lists per route (no network).
{ "verb": "models" }
// Probe the backend health (the live /models probe).
{ "verb": "status" }
```

## Troubleshooting

A failing call returns the document `{ ok: false, error: { code, message,
provider?, elapsed_ms } }`. The code set is `invalid_param` / `config` /
`network` / `timeout` / `http` / `protocol` / `output`.

- When a `config` error carries the message "no provider route is
  configured", no route survived configuration. Check the base URLs; the tool
  reports each route that configuration drops as a warning in the log.
- When a `config` error carries the message "credential missing: environment
  variable "X" is not set", the credential reference does not resolve. Set
  `X` in the environment or add it to `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`.
- When a `config` error carries the message "unknown provider "x"", the route
  name matches no configured route. Route names match case-insensitively and
  treat `_` and `-` as the same separator; the error lists the configured
  names.
- When a `config` error carries the message "multiple providers configured
  (...) and no default is set", pass the `provider` argument explicitly, or
  set `IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, or set the settings `defaultProvider`.
- When an `output` error carries the message "write failed", the tool could
  not write to the `out` path. Check the directory and its permissions.
- When an `output` error carries the message "not a recognized image", the
  backend returned bytes with no PNG, JPEG, or WebP magic. Inspect the kept
  file; the backend may return an unsupported container.

## Build

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # tsc -> lib/
pnpm run lint      # eslint src/ test/
pnpm run selftest  # in-process: HTTP stub + config matrix + magic-byte checks
```

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。方向在面板内直接填，回车即开始。
- **横向对比版本**：版本链横着排，每一版一列，内容直接铺开，不用点开就能看到；每一版都跟左边一版做行级对比，新增标绿、删除标红并划掉。
- **等待有反馈**：优化与迭代期间显示进度条和已等待秒数。
- **模板与历史**：五个内置模板（通用优化 / 结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入（载入后自动切回「优化」页）。「存入历史」把结果那一栏当前的内容存成一条手写版本；「存为模板」才是存成可复用的模板。
- **在新对话中使用**：优化结果那一栏可以直接手改；改完点「在新对话中使用」，选一个工作区，插件就会新开一个对话、把这段提示词填进输入框并直接发送，省掉复制粘贴。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代的系统提示词，以及容错清理
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: Model-free local-handoff compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compaction-local-handoff

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**零模型调用**压缩后端：上下文到达阈值后，用本地、确定性、有界的交接文档代替一次额外的模型摘要调用。

> **English:** A model-free compaction backend for DeepSeek Harness. When the context reaches the compaction threshold, it replaces the extra summarization LLM call with a deterministic, bounded handoff assembled locally from the messages being shadowed — no model call, no cost, no added latency, and reproducible output. Everything else about compaction (trigger threshold, verbatim tail retention, tool-result pruning, span selection, locking, `/compact`) is inherited unchanged from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`. Install it with one `dsh plugin add` plus a host restart, and remove the bundle to get the default backend back.

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11（PowerShell） | ✅ | DSH_HOME 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`。npm 会生成 `dsh.cmd` / `dsh.ps1`，本仓库的 preset 查找识别 `PATHEXT`，`npm run dev:link` 使用目录 junction（无需管理员权限）。已在 Windows 11 + Node 24.19.0 上实机跑通全部测试。 |
| macOS（zsh） | ✅ | DSH_HOME 是 `~/.dsh`。npm 全局 `dsh` 通常是指向真实 `lib/bin.js` 的符号链接，preset 查找会先解析它。查找逻辑有 darwin 布局的单元测试，未在真机重复验证。 |
| Linux（bash/zsh） | ✅ | 与 macOS 同一套 Node 代码路径，`dev:link` 用普通目录符号链接。查找逻辑有 linux 布局的单元测试，未在真机重复验证。 |

运行要求：

- **Node.js**：`>=22`（取自 `package.json` 的 `engines`）。
- **DSH peer**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic >=0.2.0-rc.2`（取自 `package.json` 的 `peerDependencies`）。该包由 DSH 自带，必须能从 profile 的 `node_modules` 解析到；本仓库不 vendor 它。
- 纯 ESM，**无构建步骤、无新增 npm 依赖**。

## 安装

1. **确认 Node 和 `dsh` 可用**（PowerShell 与 zsh 相同）：

   ```powershell
   node --version
   dsh --version
   ```

   `node` 需要 `v22` 或更高；`dsh --version` 能输出版本号（本机验证时为 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。

2. **安装 bundle**（两个平台逐字相同，不要改写命令）：

   ```powershell
   dsh plugin --profile web add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
   ```

   这条命令把包写进 profile 的 `dependencies`，并把声明了 `dsh.bundle` 的它追加进有序的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表。两者缺一不可：前者让 Node 能找到模块，后者让它作为补丁层参与启动。

3. **重启该 profile 的 host**。新增模块根不在 HMR 热重载范围内：必须完全退出并重新启动运行 `dsh` 的进程（GUI 即重启应用/后台服务）。只刷新页面、只重载配置都不够。

4. 按[验证](#验证)确认它真的在跑本地后端。

**平台差异只有路径**：

- Windows：DSH_HOME 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，profile 目录是 `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web`。
- macOS / Linux：DSH_HOME 是 `~/.dsh`，profile 目录是 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`。
- `dsh plugin …` 本身没有平台差异。

### 手工安装（等价做法）

`dsh plugin add` 只是把 pnpm 和 bundle 选择一起做了。也可以手工两步（手工路径要求 `pnpm` 在 PATH；没有就先 `npm i -g pnpm`，或者直接用 `dsh plugin add`，它会用 DSH 安装自带的 pnpm）：

```powershell
# Windows PowerShell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web
pnpm add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
```

```zsh
# macOS / Linux
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
```

然后把包名加入该目录 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "dsh-compaction-local-handoff"
] } }
```

### 为什么 `cordis.patch.yml` 是生成出来的

压缩后端在 profile 里被挂了**两层**，只改一层不够：

1. **profile 根**——`dsh-base` 直接挂了一行 `compaction-basic`；没有自己压缩组的 preset（自定义 preset）继承它。当前随 DSH 发布的四个 preset 都有各自的压缩组。
2. **每个 agent preset 内部的隔离压缩组**——`preset-standard` / `preset-ptc` / `preset-minimal` / `preset-cordis` 各自带一个 `cordis:group`，带 `isolate: { compaction: true }`，里面又挂了一份 `compaction-basic`。**正常 GUI 会话跑在 preset 下，用的是这一份。**

第 2 层无法用普通的按 id patch 命中：preset 行的 `config.plugins` 是**数据**，交给 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` 注册后才在 agent 自己的 scope 里挂载，而 loader 的 `applyEntryPatches` 只下钻 `group: true` 的行（preset 行不是）。

registry 的文档给了官方做法——“A new preset or an override of a shipped one is a bundle patch: an `insert` of a `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row, **or a patch keyed by that row's id**”。所以 `cordis.patch.yml` 由 `scripts/sync-presets.mjs` 生成：读**官方发布的 manifest 文件** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`，**逐字复制**，只把那份 `compaction-basic` 换成 `compaction-local-handoff`，其余（persona、plan-mode、delegation……）保持原样。

来源必须是 manifest 文件，**不能**是 `dsh --dump-default-config`：这个 bundle 自己就是一个 bundle，等 dump 渲染出来时它自己的补丁已经生效了——读 dump 等于读本文件的输出，于是 `check:presets` 拿文件和自己比，永远失败（“no preset with a compaction group found”）。一个**永远不可能通过**的漂移守卫比没有更糟，因为它看起来像保护。

代价要说清楚：这意味着这些 preset 清单在你的 profile 里被**冻结**在生成时的那一版。harness 升级若改动了 shipped preset（新增工具、调整 prompt 段），你不会自动拿到。反向也一样：仓库里的快照是在某个具体 harness 版本上生成的（当前为 `0.2.1-rc.2`），比它旧的 harness 可能不认识快照里新增的 preset 行；`peerDependencies` 只保证压缩钩子存在，不保证 preset 行完全一致。源码检出里可以：

```powershell
npm run check:presets     # 只比较，不写文件；过期时非零退出并打印第一处差异
npm run sync:presets      # 重新生成 cordis.patch.yml
```

- `check:presets` 把生成器当前会产出的结果与仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 比较（换行归一化后逐字节比较，不一致时打印第一处差异），不一致就退出 1。
- `sync:presets` 从你安装的 DSH 的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml` 重新生成，因此 `check:presets` 比较的其实是“仓库快照 vs 你机器上的 harness”。
- 这两条命令只在**源码检出**里有意义。普通用户经 `dsh plugin add` 安装的是已经打好的包，不需要跑；升级 harness 后如果上游改了 preset，应更新本仓库并重新安装。

生成器对上游 YAML 形状是**硬编码**的（`- insert:` 包装 + 4 空格缩进、`- id: compaction-basic` + `name:` 两行），形状一变就抛错要求更新，不会静默生成错误的东西。

## 它替换了什么

DSH 默认的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` 在上下文到达阈值后：

1. 先用 `tool-result-pruner` 无模型地剪掉超大工具结果（剪完低于阈值就结束）；
2. 仍需压缩时，**发起一次额外的 LLM 调用**（`purpose: "compaction"`）让模型按固定 8 节结构写检查点；
3. 用这条检查点替换最老的一段历史，保留最近约 16% 逐字。

本插件把第 2 步换成纯本地拼装。**第 1、3 步以及全部触发策略保持不变**。思路来自 ComeCode 的本地交接式压缩（`engine/apps/zcode-cli/packages/core/src/compact/local-handoff.ts`），但落在 DSH 官方的扩展点 `summarize()` 上，因此**不需要修改 harness 任何源码**。

| 行为 | 默认后端 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 触发阈值 | `floor(min(W × 0.8, W − O − headroom))` | 同 |
| 逐字保留近期尾部 | `retainRatio 0.16` | 同 |
| 工具结果剪枝 / 图片卸载 | 是 | 同 |
| 区间选择（工具配对安全、不遮蔽系统提示词） | 是 | 同 |
| 日志事务 / 并发锁 / 上下文溢出恢复 / `/compact` | 是 | 同 |
| 检查点怎么来 | **一次模型调用** | **本地拼装，0 次调用** |
| 检查点内容 | 模型自选措辞的 8 节 Markdown | 固定字段、逐字摘录、硬字符预算 |
| 上限 | 模型输出上限 | 6,000 字符，且不超过被遮蔽内容的一半 |
| 成本 / 延迟 | 每次触发都付费，还要等 | 免费、即时、可复现 |

## 交接文档里有什么

`<compacted-summary>` 内是一段有界文本（外层 preamble 由 DSH 自己加）：

- **guide**：不表示任务已完成；最新用户要求（压缩区间内最后一条）；提示完整原文仍在会话日志中、缺失细节按需重读。
- **summary**：阶段性要求/约束（历史内 system 更新，保留来源，标注“不作为新授权”）；压缩区间内涉及的文件（从工具调用参数提取，最多 25 个）；**回合级史书**（装了 [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) 时出现）；最近 4 次工具调用及结果（失败/成功/结果未记录）；最近一条助手进展原文摘录；未解决报错线索（最多 2 条）；上次交接摘录（非新指令）；以及“工具结果只保留预览”的收尾提示。

装了 `dsh-session-recall` 后，交接里会多一段**回合级史书**（≤2400 字符，且不超过交接预算的 40%）：它由会话日志折叠而来，所以**重复压缩也不会丢**——被上一次交接替换掉的早期回合，其结论仍然在里面。没装该 bundle 时行为与之前完全一致；史书读取失败也只会退化成没有这一段，不会让压缩失败。

各字段有独立字符预算（用户要求 1600、进展 900、单条工具 280、约束 300、旧交接 1200），总计硬上限 6,000 字符；实际预算还会被压到“被遮蔽字符数的一半减 600”（600 是给 DSH 固定 wrapper 留的余量）。凭据形态的文本（`sk-…`、`Bearer …`、`api_key=`、`password`/`secret`/`token`）会被 redact，`<thinking>` 块被剥离。

## 验证

### 1. 确认包已安装

PowerShell 与 zsh 相同：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web why dsh-compaction-local-handoff
```

预期输出（版本号以实际安装为准；`0.2.2` 是本源码检出的版本）：

```
dsh-compaction-local-handoff@0.2.2
└── dsh-profile-web (dependencies)

Found 1 version of dsh-compaction-local-handoff
```

注意：这只能证明**装上了**，不能证明 host 已经加载它。见下一步。

### 2. 确认运行时真的走了本地后端

在一个 `agentPreset: "standard"` 的 web 会话里执行 `/compact`，然后看压缩记录/会话日志：

```
17:53:57.134  compaction/start
17:53:57.145  compaction/summary   provider=local  model=local-handoff
              shadowedRange 8-61 · 21 nodes · 5713 tokens
              llmStreamCall=无 · rawOutput=无 · usage=无 · maxTokens=无
```

关键是 `provider=local`、`model=local-handoff`，且摘要事件**不带** `llmStreamCall` / `usage` / `maxTokens`——模型摘要路径一定会带这三者。节点数与 token 数应同界面报告的“已压缩 21 条历史记录（约 5713 tokens）”一致；这条记录 11 毫秒完成。

本仓库还验证过**根路径**：一次性 profile + 小窗口强制触发自动压缩（`compaction (step pressure)`），同样得到 `provider: "local"`、`model: "local-handoff"`，`compaction/start` → `compaction/summary` 间隔 2 毫秒。同时验证到：

- 交接里的“最新用户要求”是**真用户指令**，不是被注入的 `<system-reminder>`（技能目录 / AGENTS.md / 运行时上下文）；
- 反复压缩时上一次交接被当**数据合并**（最多一条 `上次交接携带的文件（可能已过时）`），不会层层嵌套；
- 被遮蔽区间变小时交接跟着变小，能通过后端的“必须比源内容更小”检查。

日志行本身不变：`compaction (step pressure): shadowed N surface nodes ...`。

想在隔离环境里试：`dsh plugin --profile <新 profile> add "<本仓库绝对路径>"`，再用小窗口强制触发自动压缩（做法同本仓库测试）。

### 3. 在源码检出里跑测试

```powershell
npm test
```

裸检出（尚未跑 `npm run dev:link`）会跳过 6 个 engine 测试：

```
ℹ tests 27
ℹ pass 21
ℹ fail 0
ℹ skipped 6
```

先跑一次 `npm run dev:link`（见[开发](#开发)），再跑：

```

ℹ pass 27
ℹ fail 0
ℹ skipped 0
```

```powershell
npm run check:presets

# dsh-agents-md-only

让 DSH 只读 `AGENTS.md` 和 `AGENTS.local.md` 作为工作区指令，不再读 `CLAUDE.md`、`CLAUDE.local.md`。

DSH 默认四个都读。Web / 桌面版的内置预设各自带一份指令加载器，profile 配置改不到它们。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:RicardoYan/dsh-agents-md-only#v0.1.2
```

Web 端把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名（一般是 `web`）。装完重启 DSH。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agents-md-only`

## 说明

- 对所有预设和会话（含子代理）生效，不需要配置
- 文件名不区分大小写；`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 照常读取
- 装上或卸下后，已有会话继续时会收到一份更新后的完整指令（只一次）
- 依赖 DSH 内部接口（`dsh-agent-instructions` 的配置字段），适用于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`

## 许可证

# dsh-model-provider-badge

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

在 DSH Web 输入框的工具行里，紧挨着模型选择器左侧显示**当前会话所用模型的供应商**。

![输入框工具行里的供应商徽标，位于模型选择器左侧](assets/screenshot-1.png)

## 它显示什么

- 供应商名称取自 Host 模型目录里该模型所属的分组名（`ModelProviderGroup.name`），与 `/model`
  弹窗、模型选择器里的分组标题一致。
- 数据源是与模型选择器**同一个** per-session 模型目录（client 服务 `modelDirectories`）：
  还没选过模型的新会话显示部署默认模型的供应商，切换模型后立即跟着变。
- 供应商已从目录移除时，依次退回上一次广告到的失败名，再退回供应商 id 本身。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:huihuangdi/dsh-model-provider-badge
```

装完**刷新一次页面**——客户端半边由 Web 外壳加载，不由 Host 加载。也可以直接指向本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-model-provider-badge
```

无构建步骤：纯 JavaScript，没有 install / 生命周期脚本，不涉及 `allowBuilds` 授权。

## 位置与实现

- 座位：`conversation.input.right`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 声明），
  在 DOM 中渲染于模型选择器之前——也就是模型名左边的空位。
- `index.js`：Host 半边，一个普通插件行，外加一个只在 profile 有 Web server 时注册的
  只写诊断路由。
- `client.js`：浏览器半边，经 `window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载，用 `ctx.slots.inject(...)` +
  `ctx.slots.register(...)` 占住座位。
- 样式只用主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-sm`），尺寸对齐宿主模型座位
  （28px 高、13px/400 字号、4px 间距），因此和同一行的控件是一套视觉。
- 文案走 client locale（命名空间 `model-provider-badge`，内置 zh / en）。

## 自检

```sh
node test/activation.selftest.mjs
```

用真实 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 复刻浏览器里的服务拓扑（服务由**兄弟插件**提供，而不是挂在 root 上），
断言插件激活成功、词典与座位注册成功、注入面只带可安全缓存的值。DSH 装在非默认位置时用
`DSH_INSTALL=<@deepseek-ai/dsh 目录>` 指定。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Progress companion for the dsh web pet: folds durable todo/write and goal/change session events into the pet's status bubble, so it reports how much work is left - not just what the model is doing right now.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-progress

**English** · [中文说明](README.zh.md)

**A progress bar for your desktop pet.**

The [dsh web pet](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-pet) shows what the agent
is doing *right now* — thinking, calling a tool, done. It has no way to show how
much of a long task is finished, so a task that is 90% done looks exactly like
one that just started.

This plugin fixes that. It reads the todo lists and goals your agent already
writes to the session, and folds them into a percentage bubble on the pet.
A session that never writes a todo list isn't left blank either — there the
bubble falls back to a plain line saying what is happening right now.

## Install

One command, using the plugin's full GitHub URL:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Elefseus/dsh-pet-progress
```

This requires the [dsh web pet](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-pet) to be
installed. If it is missing, the plugin stays loaded but publishes nothing —
you'll see a note in the dsh log rather than a crash.

**Restart DSH afterwards** — bundles are read only at startup, so the plugin
won't mount until you do. The bubble then appears on its own the next time your
agent writes a todo list or starts a goal; there is nothing to switch on.

For a named profile, use `dsh plugin --profile <name> add …`.

## What you'll see

A small bubble above the pet, updated whenever the todo list or the goal changes:

| Situation | Bubble |
| --- | --- |
| Todo list, one task in progress | `3/7 · 43%` titled with that task |
| Todo list, several tasks in progress | `3/7 · 43%`, naming them — up to three, `+N` for the rest |
| All todos done | `任务全部完成` in green — a moment, gone after about 10 seconds |
| Long-lived goal with no todos | `2/8 轮` — the goal's round budget |
| Goal finished | `目标完成` in green — also a moment |
| Goal blocked | The block reason, in place of progress |
| No todo list and no goal | A plain line with no percentage — what the model is thinking (`正在思考`), the words it is writing (`最近输出`), or what the tool it just called is for (`当前过程`) |

A standing bubble fades out about 30 seconds after the last progress update, so a
finished turn doesn't leave a stale percentage on screen; it comes back by itself
if the work resumes. A **moment** — a finished list or a finished goal — is
announced once and never renewed, so it clears itself instead of sitting there;
it also keeps the bubble for those ten seconds, because the agent usually starts
talking again immediately and would otherwise replace it before you read it.

Several sessions can be open at once — the most recently active one owns the
bubble.

## Checking the full list

The bubble is one line, so there's a button for the rest: click **进度** on the
pet panel and the complete todo list is written to the dsh log.

## Good to know

- **It never over-reports.** A todo whose status the plugin doesn't recognise
  counts as *not done*. If every entry in a write is unreadable, the plugin
  treats it as "no information" and keeps what it had.
- **It won't guess.** It names the tasks that are actually in progress — up to
  three, each trimmed to 32 characters, with `+N` when more are running. It never
  picks one of several and pretends that one is the work.
- **It reads, it doesn't judge.** A percentage comes from the todo lists and
  goals your agent writes; the plugin never infers progress from how long
  something has been running. Without either, it shows the plain activity line
  instead of a number.
- **It says what is happening, not just which phase.** With no task list it
  follows the model's own words as they stream — the thinking first, then the
  answer, newest words only, since those are the ones that say what is going on
  now — and it names what a tool call is *for* (`正在调用 pwsh：npm test`,
  `正在调用 read：progress.ts`), not only that a tool is running.

## Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.1.7-rc.1` |
| `@linxin666/dsh-pet` | `>=0.4.0` (peer) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

The plugin binds to the pet's plugin-seam contract (`announce`,
`registerPanelAction`, and the `session/event` channel); an older pet does not
expose all three.

## Configuration

```ts
apply(ctx, { enabled?: boolean, heartbeatMs?: number })
```

With `enabled: false` nothing mounts. `heartbeatMs` defaults to `10000`.

## Using it from code

The plugin is host-only (no client bundle). The pet service is available as
`ctx.pet`, and the same three seams the pet publishes are what this plugin uses:

| Seam | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.on('session/event', …)` | Reading `todo/write`, `goal/change`, and the turn/step/tool/message events behind the activity line |
| `ctx.pet.announce(…)` | Publishing the progress bubble |
| `ctx.pet.registerPanelAction(…)` | The `进度` panel button |

Adjust `PROGRESS_TTL_MS` and `MAX_TRACKED_SESSIONS` in
[`src/progress.ts`](src/progress.ts) to change the fade-out and how many sessions
are tracked at once.

## Development

`src/*.ts` is the source of truth; `lib/` is committed build output, because the
cordis loader does no transpilation. **After editing `src/`, rebuild and commit
`lib/` with it — CI fails if the two drift apart.**

```bash
node build.mjs              # rebuild lib/ from src/
node --test src/*.test.ts   # 76 tests, node:test only
```

To work on the code, skip installing and point the profile at your checkout:

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-pet-progress": "file:<absolute path to this directory>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…existing…", "dsh-pet-progress"] } }
}
```

A `bundles` entry alone is not enough — the package must also be a dependency.
If the path contains non-ASCII characters, write it as a `file://` URL. Restart
the app afterwards.

Node is pinned in `package.json` `engines` and exercised in CI at `22.19.0` and
`24.x`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop up dsh-pet-progress          # update to latest default branch
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<repo>#<tag>"           # pin a tag instead (reproducible)
```

## More

- [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) — why the plugin is built this way: the event
  gap it fills, why it's a sibling rather than a patch, what it reports, and the
  two non-obvious details (deferred mounting, and an announcement slot with no
  retract).

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic-first triage for DeepSeek Harness: a rule prefilter classifies every ticket, and anything no rule can place is needs_review rather than guessed at.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-batch-triage

**Rules decide the easy tickets. Anything the rules cannot place is handed to a
human — never quietly filed as routine.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin.
No model, no service, no network, no API key.

```
$ node -e "
  import('dsh-batch-triage').then(m => {
    const r = m.triageBatch([
      { id: 'a', text: 'The service is down for all users' },
      { id: 'b', text: 'How do I install this on Windows?' },
      { id: 'c', text: 'The frobnitz is blorp.' },
    ], m.resolveConfig({}));
    console.log(r.items.map(i => i.id + ' ' + i.class + '  ' + i.reasonCodes[0]).join('\n'));
    console.log('exit', r.exitCode, r.exitBasis);
  })"

a urgent        OUTAGE_REPORTED
b routine       INSTALL_QUESTION
c needs_review  NO_RULE_MATCHED
exit 6 modelUnavailable
```

## Quick start

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-batch-triage@0.1.4
```

batch_triage is now available; Rules place the tickets they can; anything they cannot place is returned as `needs_review` — never quietly filed as routine.


## Why rules first

A ticket batch is the wrong shape for one model call per item: the volume is high,
the interesting items are few, and every item costs a round trip whether or not it
needed one. So the order is inverted from the obvious one.

**The prefilter runs on every item, first.** Rules place the clear cases — a crash
with a stack trace is urgent, "how do I install this" is routine — and they place
them without asking anything. Only the residue would ever reach a model, and this
release does not reach one at all: it says so instead.

That ordering is not an optimisation. It is the design's main path, and it changes
what the tool is for: **the prefilter is the product, and the model is a fallback.**

## The rule that matters most

> **An item is never `routine` unless a rule said so.**

Every path that cannot classify — an empty body, no matching rule, no model
configured, a budget exhausted — produces `needs_review`. Turning "I could not
tell" into "nothing to see here" is the one failure this tool exists to prevent,
and the test suite pins it in both directions.

0.1.2 tightened what "a rule said so" is allowed to mean. A rule decides on a
*phrase*, and a ticket has more than one sentence: when the phrase that matched is a
question and another sentence reports something broken, the question rule does not get
to decide the ticket. It becomes `needs_review` with `MALFUNCTION_REPORTED`, and the
rule that would have swallowed it stays in `reasonCodes` so a reader sees both halves.

`decidedBy` says which tier actually decided:

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `prefilter` | a rule placed it; `reasonCodes` names which |
| `unavailable` | nothing could place it and no model tier is configured |
| `budget` | a cap was reached, so it was not assessed |

The last two both carry `escalate: true`. Neither is a verdict about the ticket.

## What the rules look at

A **structured field outranks the body text**: `severity: critical`,
`security: true`, `data_loss: true`, `reporter_tier: enterprise`. A reporter who
filled in a form has already told you, and no wording in the body can lower what the
field said. Wording that reports something *worse* still raises it — a field can never
bury an outage, and when the two disagree the item carries both reason codes.

Otherwise **the highest class any rule claims wins**, and the table is written
strongest first so that a tie inside a class goes to the rule listed first:

| class | rules |
|---|---|
| `urgent` | `outage`, `data_loss`, `security`, `crash_with_trace`, `blocked_workflow` |
| `needs_review` | `regression`, `wrong_result`, `performance`, `flaky` |
| `routine` | `install_question`, `usage_question`, `documentation`, `feature_request`, `thanks` |

A ticket that reports an outage *and* phrases itself as a question must not be
swallowed by the question rule. That is a test — and in 0.1.1 it was a test that could
not fail, because its fixture used wording the `outage` rule already recognised, so the
fixture and the rule shared an assumption and the precedence was never really exercised.
Precedence is by class rather than by position now, which also means a caller-supplied
`rules` array cannot reorder the table into a fail-open.

Class precedence alone was not enough, and the six measured tickets below are why.
`outage` did not know "returns 500 for every request", so *no* severity rule matched,
and the question rule decided the whole ticket from one sentence of it. So a `routine`
verdict gets one more check: if the body reports a malfunction — an error, a crash,
something "unusable", a 5xx, deleted records, a leaked credential — in wording no
severity rule could name, the item becomes `needs_review` with `MALFUNCTION_REPORTED`
instead of `routine`. That guard only ever *refuses* a `routine`; it cannot raise
anything to `urgent`, and it cannot touch a verdict a severity rule already made.

Precedence by class is chosen over "most specific wins" deliberately. A scoring system
would need weights nobody could defend; a class ladder needs none, and the table stays
inspectable — a rule that never fires is a bug you can see.

The wordings the fix was measured against, verbatim from the audit. All six were
`routine` with exit **0** on 0.1.1:

| ticket | 0.1.1 | 0.1.2 |
|---|---|---|
| `How do I install this? Also our production API returns 500 for every request.` | `routine` `INSTALL_QUESTION`, exit 0 | `urgent` `OUTAGE_REPORTED`, exit 1 |
| `Is there documentation for the auth flow? We are seeing records deleted from our database.` | `routine` `DOCUMENTATION_REQUEST`, exit 0 | `urgent` `DATA_LOSS_REPORTED`, exit 1 |
| `Feature request: please add CSV export. Meanwhile the app is unusable for our whole team.` | `routine` `FEATURE_REQUEST`, exit 0 | `urgent` `OUTAGE_REPORTED`, exit 1 |
| `How do I configure SSRF protection? Our pentest found we can read other users files.` | `routine` `INSTALL_QUESTION`, exit 0 | `urgent` `SECURITY_REPORTED`, exit 1 |
| `where can i find the logs? the service has been returning 503 all morning` | `routine` `INSTALL_QUESTION`, exit 0 | `urgent` `OUTAGE_REPORTED`, exit 1 |
| `What is the right way to rotate keys? Our API token leaked in a public repo.` | `routine` `USAGE_QUESTION`, exit 0 | `urgent` `SECURITY_REPORTED`, exit 1 |

A ticket that is *only* a question is unaffected: `How do I install this on Windows?` is
still `routine`, and a batch of nothing but routine items still exits 0. The guard is a
floor, not a bias toward urgency.

**What the guard costs, stated rather than discovered later.** It is conservative on
purpose, so a question that merely *mentions* a failure word is bumped as well:
`How do I handle errors returned by the parser?` comes out `needs_review` instead of
`routine`. The class changes; the exit code does not, because a `needs_review` the
prefilter decided is not a finding in this release. That is a real remaining gap — the
guard's own items still exit 0, which is why the six above had to land `urgent` on
their merits rather than merely `needs_review`. It is written up in the CHANGELOG
rather than left for a reader to find.

## Exit codes

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | ran, and nothing needs a human |
| `1` | ran and found something — **not a failure** |
| `2` | the call was invalid (empty batch, over the cap, malformed item) |
| `3` | the input or policy could not be honoured (duplicate `id`) |
| `4` | empty scan |
| `5` | a recorded expectation was not met |
| `6` | every item needing the model was skipped |
| `7` | a cap was zero before any item could reach the model |

The priority between them is one documented ladder in `lib/exit.mjs`, because a run
can satisfy several at once and the order decides which one you are told about:

```
2 usage → 3 config → 4 empty scan → 7 zero budget →
6 model unavailable → 5 expectation → 1 findings → 0 clean
```

A batch of 1–64 items can only reach `0`, `1`, `2`, `3` and `6`. The other three are
rungs of the ladder that this batch runner has no producer for:

* **`4` empty scan** is pre-empted by `2`: an empty batch is refused as a usage error
  b

plugins.description: System-prompt surface drift gate for DeepSeek Harness — sections any plugin contributes are hashed and baselined; silent rewrites fail loud
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-drift

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

System-prompt surface drift gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Any plugin or preset can contribute sections to the assembled system prompt.
Upgrading one can silently rewrite what the model is **told**; a malicious
one can inject "ignore all safety rules" straight into the prompt. This
plugin hooks the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall, hashes every section
(name → sha256(text)), baselines the surface, and diffs every later
assembly against it. **dsh-mcp-test guards what the model can call; this
guards what the model is told.** Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. The nearest neighbour (`dsh-modelprint`, 0★) fingerprints model
config, not the prompt surface. Prompt-injection plugins scan *content
flowing in*; nobody watches the assembled prompt itself — the one channel
every plugin can write to without anyone reviewing a diff.

## How it works

```
system-prompt/assemble ──> sections [{name, sha256(text)}] name-sorted
                     ──> baseline absent? freeze it (commit the file)
                     ──> diff: added / removed / changed sections
                     ──> warn once per distinct drift (signature dedup)
```

Dynamic sections (cwd, timestamps) can be excluded via `ignoreSections`.
Baseline file is stable, name-sorted JSON — commit it; it is the contract.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-drift
  name: dsh-prompt-drift
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-prompt-drift/baseline.json
    rebaselineOnDrift: false
    ignoreSections: []
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-prompt-drift] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-prompt-drift` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party prompt-surface pinning, this freezes at its last
working version with a postmortem here.

plugins.description: 使用atomcode工具审核代码，查看本机应用返回的5小时用量。
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-connect-atomcode

把本机已登录的 AtomCode（官方终端 AI 编程助手）接成 DeepSeek Harness 的独立第二意见。

安装 · 工作原理 · 更新日志 · 问题反馈

把本机已登录的 [AtomCode](https://atomgit.com/atomgit_atomcode/atomcode)（官方二进制，终端 AI 编程助手）接成 DeepSeek Harness 的**独立第二意见**。 **写完代码，换一双眼睛再读一遍。** > 主会话模型检查自己刚写的东西时，读的是同一份上下文、沿着同一条思路——它看不出自己刚才的判断错在哪。AtomCode 是另一套模型、另一套上下文、另一套工具循环，读同一份代码得出的是独立判断。这不是「多一个工具」，是**换一双眼睛**。 ## 30 秒上手 1. **装上**：`dsh plugin add dsh-connect-atomcode` → **重启 DSH 进程**（patch 在启动时读取；只改前端时刷新浏览器即可）。其余装法与前置见 [安装](#安装)。 2. **用上**：对话里说一句「用 atomcode_ask 锐评一下当前代码」，主模型自己组织提问；不想让主模型插手时，按每条回复下方的**「锐评」按钮**，或直接打 `/atomcode-review <评审目标>`。 3. **看额度**：输入框下方的 `atom · 4% · 48m50s 后重置` 标签（下面截图里那个）就是 CodingPlan 窗口用量与重置倒计时，点开是详情。为什么是这个数字见 [📊 CodingPlan 额度显示](#-codingplan-额度显示)。 ![在对话里打 `/atomcode-review`：命令发出后由宿主侧直接执行，评审结论以一张卡片投递回会话（这一步不花模型回合），主模型据此接着原任务往下走；右下角是输入框下的 CodingPlan 额度弹窗与紧凑标签](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-atomcode/master/assets/atomcode-review.png) **先知道三条，省得装完才发现**： - **无 API Key** —— ask 与 `/atomcode-review` 都走本机 daemon token（`~/.atomcode/daemon-13459.json`），网关签名内置于官方二进制；不接任何外部 Key。 - **免费，但有配额** —— 消耗的是**你自己 AtomGit 账号免费领取的 CodingPlan 额度**（`atomcode login` 领取的限时体验版，按 5 小时滚动窗口计量、同样限流）。它不计入当前 DSH 会话的 token 账单，仅此而已：**别把它当无限量**，窗口用满就得等重置。 - **挑场合，不是每次改完都跑** —— 改动涉及核心逻辑、并发/安全/数据正确性，或你自己对结果没把握时，值得花这一次；改样式、改文案这类小改动，等用户点名再跑。工具描述里写的主动调用条件与此同源，**改一处就要改另一处**。 ## 它给你什么 三个交付物，①③ 零配置即得： | 交付物 | 形态 | 底层 | 本机状态 | |---|---|---|---| | `atomcode_ask` | **主力**：一条消息进，一个完整自主回合出（自带工具循环，能自己决定读哪些文件、跑哪些命令） | daemon `POST /chat`（SSE，token 走 `~/.atomcode/daemon-13459.json`） | ✅ 实测可用 | | `/atomcode-review` | **辅助**：评审未提交改动 / base 分支 / PR / diff 文本 / 自定义任务，宿主侧执行，**不花模型回合** | 走 daemon `POST /chat`（与 ask 同一条通道；有界：轮数 + 墙钟双保险丝） | ✅ 与 ask 同等可用 | | CodingPlan 额度显示 | 详情页卡片 + 输入框下紧凑标签，额度走同账号登录态，不接任何外部 Key | 本地额度文本解析（见 [额度一节](#-codingplan-额度显示)） | ✅ 零配置 | **模型的工具表里只有一个工具**：`atomcode_ask`。早先并存的 `atomcode_review` 工具已退役——模型需要评审时直接调 `atomcode_ask` 并让它自己决定读什么；一次性的差分自查交给 `/atomcode-review` 命令或「锐评」按钮。 **两者的边界不是「一个随便问、一个专业评审」，而是读得多与读得少**：`/atomcode-review` 只能看一个 diff，`atomcode_ask` 能自己决定读哪些文件、跑哪些命令、顺着调用链往下追。所以真正能判断「这段设计对不对」的只有 ask；review 是省 token 的窄口自查。两者走同一条 daemon 通道（单通道决定），review 的代价是没有结构化 `findings[]`——AtomCode 自己跑 `git diff`、写报告，报告是文字。 ## 使用 | 你的情形 | 用哪个 | 为什么 | |---|---|---| | 不确定问题在哪 / 要看调用链 | `atomcode_ask` | 它能自己决定读什么、读多少 | | 已经知道评哪块（一个 PR / 未提交改动 / 两个分支的差异） | `/atomcode-review <评审目标>` | 一次有界的差分自查，省 token | | 不写提问词、也不想让主模型插手 | 每条回复下方的**「锐评」按钮** | 它把那条回复填成 `/atomcode-review` 的目标，**不自动发送**，你按回车才跑 | - **让主会话模型去问**（日常主力）：直接说「用 atomcode_ask 锐评一下当前代码」——模型自己会组织提问，因为它清楚刚改了什么；它带着 AtomCode 的判断回来，**判断是 AtomCode 下的，不是它自己补的**。`continue: true` 接着刚才那条线再问（自动恢复上次 AtomCode session，不用记 id）；续线接到过期的 daemon 会话时用 `reset_session: true` 重新开线。 - **评审的前提**：`working_dir` 已给或已配（插件不猜仓库，三层取不到就拒绝）；报告原文在 `report` 字段（文字，没有结构化 `findings[]`）。 ## 安装 **前置**： - **官方** AtomCode 二进制（v5.x）在 PATH——Windows 实测位 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AtomCode\atomcode.exe`；也可用 `ATOMCODE_BIN` 或 patch 的 `binary` 覆盖。源码构建无 AtomGit 网关签名，默认网关模型不可用 - **macOS 上「装在 PATH 里」不等于「宿主看得见」**：从访达 / 应用图标启动的 DSH 继承的是 launchd 的 PATH，不是登录 shell 的，于是 Homebrew 装好的 `atomcode` 在终端能用、插件却说找不到。这种情形**开箱即用**：自动探测失败后插件会依次试 `/opt/homebrew/bin/atomcode`（Apple Silicon）与 `/usr/local/bin/atomcode`（Intel），只试这两个真实存在的路径。两处都没有时**面板会写明**去跑的是哪个可执行文件、系统报的是哪个错（`ENOENT` 没找到 / `EACCES` 没有执行权限），以及该怎么修——不再是面板上一句无解的「自动拉起失败」 - 你自己在 patch 里写下的 `binary` **不会**被这个回退覆盖：那是你点名要跑的可执行文件，找不到就如实报错，不偷偷换一个能跑的 - **已登录**：`~/.atomcode/auth.toml`（`atomcode status` 可查） - **默认模型可用**：`~/.atomcode/config.toml` 的 `default_model`，或给工具传 `provider` - ask 需要 daemon：`atomcode daemon --port 13459`（插件默认自动 detached 拉起，实测冷启动约 1.5–4.5s；`auto_start: false` 则需自启） bundle 形式（与本机 `dsh-connect-*` 同品类），三种装法任选： 1. **npm 包**（普通用户，已发 registry）：`dsh plugin add dsh-connect-atomcode`；或在 `plugin_manager` 里 `install_bundle` 且 `target` 填 `dsh-connect-atomcode` 2. **GitHub 直装**（走 git dep，装 `main`）：`dsh plugin add eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-atomcode` 3. **本地开发**（link 开发副本，一条命令装/卸）：`dsh plugin --profile web add link:<开发目录>` 与 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-connect-atomcode`。DSH CLI 代跑 pnpm，装完自动 reconcile `dsh.profile.bundles`（新 bundle 默认启用），不用手改 profile 的 `package.json` / `pnpm-lock` / `node_modules`；锁文件里 pnpm 会把绝对路径规范成相对 `link:../../plugins/...`。GUI 插件页只装 registry 包，`link:` 开发副本走 CLI bundle 自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`）自动声明插入行与全部配置项，无需再写 profile patch。**装完重启 DSH 进程**——patch 在启动时读取、Host 半边只在启动时加载一次；只改 `client.js` 刷新浏览器即可。 > 本插件收录于社区精选列表 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)（`dsh plugin add` 一键安装的 DSH 插件目录）。 > > **npm 副本只含运行所需的那几样**（`files` 白名单：`lib/`、`client.js`、`icon.svg`、`locale/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`、`LICENSE`）——`docs/`、`AGENTS.md`、`RELEASING.md`、`scripts/`、`test/`、`assets/` 都不在包里（`assets/` 与 `screenshots.json` 是「仓库根可见、不进 npm 包」的既有策略），所以文内指向它们的相对链接只在 GitHub 仓库里有效。下方两条 `AGENTS.md` / `RELEASING.md` 的入口因此写成 GitHub 绝对地址。**两张截图走 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 的绝对地址**，因此 registry 页上也能看到；市场读的截图仍取仓库根 `assets/` 与 `screenshots.json`（截图**不进包**是既有策略，`test/release-artifacts.test.mjs` 钉着它）。 ## 配置（patch 行 `config:`） **字段语义的真源是 [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)**——每个字段的完整注释（含为什么是这个默认值）都在那里，本表只回答「叫什么 / 默认 / 干什么」。面板**不提供输入框**的字段（`approval_mode`、`default_reasoning_effort`、`working_dir`、`ask_max_rounds`）只能在 patch 里改；详情页的「回合边界」行会标出这是插件默认还是**你改过**（判断来自 host 的 `config.authored`，不是值比较）。 ![详情页「运行统计」卡片：启动情况、运行环境（默认档位 + 推理力度）、回合边界。下拉里写 `不覆盖（用配置 …）` 的一行表示这一项没有面板值、正落在 patch 的 `config:` 上；一旦在面板上选过，那行才换成你的选择](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-atomcode/master/assets/atomcode-setting.png) | 键 | 默认 | 一句说明 | |---|---|---| | `port` | `13459` | ask 用的 daemon 端口（刻意避开 AtomCode TUI 的 13456） | | `auto_start` | `true` | 探测不到 daemon 时 detached 拉起。**面板或额度标签一被轮询就会触发**（ask 路径也会），不再是"等第一次调工具才拉" | | `binary` | `''` | 二进制名/路径（空 = PATH；`ATOMCODE_BIN` 亦可） | | `approval_mode` | `AtomGit-glm5.3-flash`），`atomcode_ask` 与 `/atomcode-review` 共用。优先级：参数 > 面板选择 > 本字段 > AtomCode 自己的默认；空 = 本层不插手。详见「怎么换 AtomCode 用的模型」 | | `default_reasoning_effort` | `''` | 随每个 `/chat`
